subject: Follow-Up Required: Outstanding Request from 10 February 2026 & Portfolio Review
body:
Dear Fong Enterprises Family Office,

I am writing to follow up on a matter recorded on 10 February 2026. At that time, a request was made that has not yet been delivered, and I note that no subsequent follow-up has been logged on our side since. I would like to ensure this is addressed promptly and would welcome the opportunity to clarify the outstanding item with you directly.

Separately, in reviewing the portfolio, I note that 20.4% of total wealth is currently allocated to Global Corporate exposure, spread across three positions within a single instrument type. Given the concentration this represents, I believe it would be worthwhile to discuss the composition and liquidity profile of this allocation together.

This discussion is also timely in light of the USD 900,000 commitment earmarked for the G3 education programme, due 1 September 2026. I would like to review with you the liquidity position supporting this obligation to ensure the funding timeline can be comfortably met.

I would welcome the opportunity to meet at your convenience to go through these points in detail and address any questions you may have. Please let me know a date and time that would suit you.

Yours sincerely,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
